# Proof Port

Rewriting a custom SAP transaction is easy. Proving the rewrite does the same thing isn't. Proof Port ports one and
lets the old transaction grade the new one, on tests sealed before the port.

Built at EVOLVE, 8090's AI hackathon in Redwood City, 13 to 14 November 2026. This repo was started at the event and
is being built there; its commit history is the record of what was made when.

## What it does

Give it a custom SAP transaction (a module pool: screens, flow logic, ABAP, dictionary) and it hands back a new
implementation on the same database tables, with a proof page saying how closely the two behave.

1. **Extract.** Read the transaction and everything it uses in the customer namespace. SAP's own objects are listed
   by name and never read.
2. **Oracle.** Replay any sequence of screen inputs through the old transaction by batch input and record what the
   screen says and what it leaves in the tables.
3. **Tests.** One agent writes cases from the extract alone; the oracle answers them. The cases are sealed: their
   SHA-256 is committed here before the port starts, and the cases themselves only after grading.
4. **Port.** A second agent, walled off from the cases, builds a RAP business object and an OData V4 service on the
   same tables, with a Fiori Elements app.
5. **Grade.** Every sealed case through the old screen and the new service; compare messages and rows. Then break
   the port on purpose and check the grader goes red.
6. **Proof page.** The score, every difference in words, and what was checked and what wasn't.

## Built before the event

- The legacy transactions are the input and were made before the event: ZCRED (mine) and ZMM01, from
  [trymytoolkit/sap-retail-z-sandbox](https://github.com/trymytoolkit/sap-retail-z-sandbox) (MIT, Romain Hecquet).
  They live on the SAP system, not in this repo.
- The SAP ABAP developer trial runs on a cloud VM under SAP's licence. It is not in this repo, and neither is any SAP
  standard code.
- An earlier private prototype of this approach was built 4 to 9 November 2026. None of its code is in this repo.
  What carried over is what I learned.
- Saybooks, if shown in the demo, is my separate product (AGPL, saybooks.io) and not part of this submission. The
  same goes for the ECC model client, a separate project on the same SAP system.

## Tools and licences

This list grows as the build does.

- Claude Code and Claude models (Anthropic, under Anthropic's commercial terms)
- Python standard library (Python Software Foundation License)
- SAP ABAP Development Tools REST interface and batch input, on the SAP ABAP developer trial (SAP's trial licence)

## Licence

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

PROGRAM sapmzcred.

DATA: ok_code      TYPE sy-ucomm,
      gv_kunnr     TYPE c LENGTH 10,
      gv_name1     TYPE c LENGTH 35,
      gv_waers     TYPE c LENGTH 5,
      gv_old_limit TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
      gv_new_limit TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
      gv_reason    TYPE c LENGTH 60,
      gs_cust      TYPE zcr_customer.

MODULE status_main OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'ZMAIN'.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE lock_priority OUTPUT.
  IF gs_cust-priority = 'V'.
    LOOP AT SCREEN.
      IF screen-name = 'GV_NEW_LIMIT'.
        screen-input = 0.
        MODIFY SCREEN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE exit_command INPUT.
  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE check_customer INPUT.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer INTO gs_cust
    WHERE kunnr = gv_kunnr.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE 'Customer not found' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
  IF gs_cust-blocked = 'X'.
    MESSAGE 'Customer is blocked' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE f4_customer INPUT.
  PERFORM f4_customer.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CLEAR ok_code.
  gv_name1     = gs_cust-name1.
  gv_waers     = gs_cust-waers.
  gv_old_limit = gs_cust-credit_limit.
  gv_new_limit = gs_cust-credit_limit.
  CLEAR gv_reason.
  LEAVE TO SCREEN 200.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE check_change INPUT.
  DATA lv_threshold TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.

  CHECK ok_code = 'SAVE'.

  IF gv_new_limit < 0.
    MESSAGE 'Credit limit cannot be negative' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_new_limit = gs_cust-credit_limit.
    MESSAGE 'Credit limit is unchanged' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR lv_threshold.
  SELECT SINGLE threshold FROM zcr_limit_rule INTO lv_threshold
    WHERE waers = gs_cust-waers.

  IF gv_new_limit > lv_threshold AND gv_reason IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE 'A reason is required for this limit' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0200 INPUT.
  DATA lv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  lv_ucomm = ok_code.
  CLEAR ok_code.

  IF lv_ucomm = 'SAVE'.
    PERFORM save_change.
    MESSAGE 'Credit limit changed' TYPE 'S'.
    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

FORM save_change.
  DATA ls_log TYPE zcr_changelog.

  GET TIME STAMP FIELD ls_log-changed_at.
  ls_log-kunnr     = gs_cust-kunnr.
  ls_log-waers     = gs_cust-waers.
  ls_log-old_limit = gs_cust-credit_limit.
  ls_log-new_limit = gv_new_limit.
  ls_log-uname     = sy-uname.
  ls_log-reason    = gv_reason.

  gs_cust-credit_limit = gv_new_limit.
  IF gv_new_limit = 0.
    gs_cust-blocked = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

  UPDATE zcr_customer FROM gs_cust.
  INSERT zcr_changelog FROM ls_log.
  COMMIT WORK.
ENDFORM.

* F4 on the customer: every customer in ZCR_CUSTOMER, with the column headings the table itself doesn't have.
FORM f4_customer.
  DATA: lt_cust   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcr_customer,
        lt_all    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dfies,
        lt_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dfies,
        ls_field  TYPE dfies.

  SELECT * FROM zcr_customer INTO TABLE @lt_cust ORDER BY kunnr.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET'
    EXPORTING
      tabname   = 'ZCR_CUSTOMER'
    TABLES
      dfies_tab = lt_all
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS    = 1.

  LOOP AT lt_all INTO ls_field.
    CASE ls_field-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KUNNR'.
        ls_field-reptext = 'Customer'.
      WHEN 'NAME1'.
        ls_field-reptext = 'Name'.
      WHEN 'WAERS'.
        ls_field-reptext = 'Currency'.
      WHEN 'BLOCKED'.
        ls_field-reptext = 'Blocked'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        CONTINUE.
    ENDCASE.
    ls_field-scrtext_s = ls_field-reptext.
    ls_field-scrtext_m = ls_field-reptext.
    ls_field-scrtext_l = ls_field-reptext.
    APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
  ENDLOOP.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield    = 'KUNNR'
      dynpprog    = sy-repid
      dynpnr      = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield = 'GV_KUNNR'

"""Stage 2: the oracle. Replay screen inputs through the old transaction and record what it does.

A case is a list of steps. Each step names a screen, the fields typed into it and the function code pressed:

    {"id": "c001", "steps": [
        {"screen": "0100", "fields": {"GV_KUNNR": "C100"}, "ok": "/00"},
        {"screen": "0200", "fields": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": "7000"}, "ok": "SAVE"}]}

Values are typed as a user would type them, in the SAP user's own number and date notation. The report on SAP
takes a snapshot of the transaction's tables first, and for every case runs CALL TRANSACTION by batch input,
records the messages and every row of the tables afterwards, then puts the snapshot back. So each case starts from
the same data, and the tables end as they began.

    python3 factory/oracle.py ZCRED cases.json [out.json]
"""
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import abap  # noqa: E402
import sap  # noqa: E402

BATCH = 40

TYPES = r"""
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_base,
         tab  TYPE tabname,
         data TYPE REF TO data,
       END OF ty_base.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_msg,
         type   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
         id     TYPE symsgid,
         number TYPE string,
         text   TYPE string,
         screen TYPE string,
       END OF ty_msg.
DATA: gt_bdc  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bdcdata,
      gt_msg  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bdcmsgcoll,
      gt_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_base.
"""

FORMS = r"""
FORM snapshot USING iv_tab TYPE tabname.
  DATA lr TYPE REF TO data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  CREATE DATA lr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_tab).
  ASSIGN lr->* TO <lt>.
  SELECT * FROM (iv_tab) INTO TABLE <lt>.
  APPEND VALUE #( tab = iv_tab data = lr ) TO gt_base.
ENDFORM.

FORM restore.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  LOOP AT gt_base INTO DATA(ls_base).
    ASSIGN ls_base-data->* TO <lt>.
    DELETE FROM (ls_base-tab).
    INSERT (ls_base-tab) FROM TABLE <lt>.
  ENDLOOP.
  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
ENDFORM.

FORM dyn USING iv_prog TYPE csequence iv_dynp TYPE csequence.
  APPEND VALUE #( program = iv_prog dynpro = iv_dynp dynbegin = 'X' ) TO gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.

FORM fld USING iv_name TYPE csequence iv_value TYPE csequence.
  APPEND VALUE #( fnam = iv_name fval = iv_value ) TO gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.

FORM run USING iv_id TYPE csequence.
  DATA: lv_subrc TYPE i,
        lv_json  TYPE string,
        lv_text  TYPE string,
        lv_n     TYPE i,
        lr       TYPE REF TO data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  CLEAR gt_msg.
  DATA(ls_opt) = VALUE ctu_params( dismode = 'N' updmode = 'S' defsize = 'X' ).
  CALL TRANSACTION '{tcode}' USING gt_bdc OPTIONS FROM ls_opt MESSAGES INTO gt_msg.
  lv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  DATA(ls_last) = VALUE ty_msg( type = sy-msgty id = sy-msgid number = sy-msgno ).
  IF sy-msgty IS NOT INITIAL.
    MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER sy-msgno WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ls_last-text.
  ENDIF.
  lv_json = |\{"id":"{ iv_id }","subrc":{ lv_subrc },"last":| && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_last )
    && `,"messages":[`.
  LOOP AT gt_msg INTO DATA(ls_m).
    MESSAGE ID ls_m-msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER ls_m-msgnr WITH ls_m-msgv1 ls_m-msgv2 ls_m-msgv3 ls_m-msgv4
      INTO lv_text.
    IF lv_n > 0.
      lv_json = lv_json && `,`.
    ENDIF.
    lv_n = lv_n + 1.
    lv_json = lv_json && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = VALUE ty_msg( type = ls_m-msgtyp id = ls_m-msgid
      number = ls_m-msgnr text = lv_text screen = |{ ls_m-dyname } { ls_m-dynumb }| ) ).
  ENDLOOP.
  lv_json = lv_json && `],"tables":{`.
  lv_n = 0.
  LOOP AT gt_base INTO DATA(ls_base).
    CREATE DATA lr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (ls_base-tab).
    ASSIGN lr->* TO <lt>.
    SELECT * FROM (ls_base-tab) INTO TABLE <lt>.
    IF lv_n > 0.
      lv_json = lv_json && `,`.
    ENDIF.
    lv_n = lv_n + 1.
    lv_json = lv_json && |"{ ls_base-tab }":| && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = <lt> ).
  ENDLOOP.
  lv_json = lv_json && `}}`.
  PERFORM out USING 'CASE' lv_json.
  PERFORM restore.
  CLEAR gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.
"""


def lit(value):
    return "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'"


def case_abap(case, program):
    lines = []
    for step in case["steps"]:
        lines.append(f"PERFORM dyn USING {lit(step.get('program', program))} {lit(step['screen'])}.")
        for name, value in step.get("fields", {}).items():
            lines.append(f"PERFORM fld USING {lit(name)} {lit(value)}.")
        lines.append(f"PERFORM fld USING 'BDC_OKCODE' {lit(step.get('ok', '/00'))}.")
    lines.append(f"PERFORM run USING {lit(case['id'])}.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def load_summary(tcode):
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "runs", tcode, "extract", "summary.json")
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)


def replay(tcode, cases, s=None):
    """Run cases through the old transaction. Returns {case id: {"subrc", "messages", "tables"}}."""
    s = s or sap.Sap()
    summary = load_summary(tcode)
    snapshot = "\n".join(f"PERFORM snapshot USING {lit(t)}." for t in summary["tables"])
    results = {}
    for i in range(0, len(cases), BATCH):
        batch = cases[i:i + BATCH]
        body = snapshot + "\n" + "\n".join(case_abap(c, summary["program"]) for c in batch)
        records = abap.run(s, os.environ.get("ORACLE_REPORT", "ZPP_ORACLE"), body + "\n" + FORMS.replace("{tcode}", summary["tcode"]), types=TYPES)
        for kind, payload in records:
            if kind == "CASE":
                r = json.loads(payload)
                r["messages"] = [{k.lower(): v for k, v in m.items()} for m in r["messages"]]
                r["last"] = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r["last"].items()}
                results[r.pop("id")] = r
        missing = [c["id"] for c in batch if c["id"] not in results]
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit(f"no result for {missing}; see python3 factory/dumps.py")
    return results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    tcode, path = sys.argv[1].upper(), sys.argv[2]
    with open(path) as f:
        cases = json.load(f)
    out = replay(tcode, cases)
    text = json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
    if len(sys.argv) > 3:
        with open(sys.argv[3], "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    else:
        print(text)

1	"""Stage 5: grade the port against the old transaction.
2	
3	Every case goes through the old screen (the oracle, run fresh) and through the new service (the port's driver),
4	each starting from the same data. Then the error messages and every table row are compared.
5	
6	    python3 factory/grade.py ZCRED CASES.json [--out report.json]      cases of your own
7	    python3 factory/grade.py ZCRED --sealed [--out report.json]         the sealed cases (factory only)
8	
9	The driver is runs/<TCODE>/port/driver.py with a function run(client, steps). It gets an odata.Client for the new
10	service (runs/<TCODE>/port/service.json names the service root) and the steps of one case, and does what a user of
11	the new app would do to achieve the same. It returns nothing; the grader reads the messages from the client's calls
12	and the rows from the database.
13	"""
14	import hashlib
15	import importlib.util
16	import json
17	import os
18	import sys
19	import time
20	
21	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
22	import abap  # noqa: E402
23	import odata  # noqa: E402
24	import oracle  # noqa: E402
25	import sap  # noqa: E402
26	
27	ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
28	VOLATILE_ROLLS = {"TIMESTAMP", "TIMESTAMPL", "TZNTSTMPS", "TZNTSTMPL", "SYUZEIT", "UZEIT"}
29	STOPPED = ("00", "344")  # batch input: the steps ran out on a screen, so the user stopped there
30	
31	
32	def load_json(path):
33	    with open(path) as f:
34	        return json.load(f)

37	def volatile_fields(tcode):
38	    d = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "extract", "dictionary.json"))
39	    out = {}
40	    for table, t in d["tables"].items():
41	        out[table] = {f["FIELDNAME"] for f in t["fields"]
42	                      if f["ROLLNAME"] in VOLATILE_ROLLS or f["DATATYPE"] == "TIMS"}
43	    return out
44	
45	
46	def table_fields(tcode):
47	    d = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "extract", "dictionary.json"))
48	    return {t: [f["FIELDNAME"] for f in v["fields"] if not f["FIELDNAME"].startswith(".")] for t, v in
49	            d["tables"].items()}
50	
51	
52	def read_tables(s, fields):
53	    return {t: s.sql(f"SELECT {', '.join(fl)} FROM {t}") for t, fl in fields.items()}
54	
55	
56	def lit(v):
57	    return "'" + str(v).replace("'", "''") + "'"
58	
59	
60	def restore_report(baseline, fields):
61	    lines = []
62	    for table, rows in baseline.items():
63	        lines.append(f"DATA lt_{table.lower()} TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF {table.lower()}.")
64	        for r in rows:
65	            assigns = " ".join(f"{f.lower()} = {lit(r[f])}" for f in fields[table] if f != "MANDT" and r[f] != "")
66	            lines.append(f"APPEND VALUE {table.lower()}( {assigns} ) TO lt_{table.lower()}.")
67	        lines.append(f"DELETE FROM {table.lower()}.")
68	        lines.append(f"INSERT {table.lower()} FROM TABLE lt_{table.lower()}.")
69	    lines.append("COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.")
70	    lines.append("PERFORM out USING 'DONE' `{}`.")
71	    return "\n".join(lines)
72	
73	
74	def norm(value):
75	    """Compare numbers as numbers: the oracle writes 7000.00 as 7000.0, the database as '7000.00'."""
76	    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
77	        return repr(float(value))
78	    text = str(value).strip()
79	    try:
80	        if text and any(c.isdigit() for c in text) and text.replace(".", "", 1).replace("-", "", 1).isdigit():
81	            return repr(float(text))
82	    except ValueError:
83	        pass
84	    return text
85	
86	
87	def normalise_rows(rows, volatile):
88	    out = []
89	    for r in rows:
90	        row = {}
91	        for k, v in r.items():
92	            if k == "MANDT":
93	                continue
94	            row[k] = ("<set>" if norm(v) not in ("", "0.0") else "<empty>") if k in volatile else norm(v)
95	        out.append(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True))
96	    return sorted(out)
97	
98	
99	def errors(messages):
100	    out = []
101	    for m in messages:
102	        if (m.get("id"), str(m.get("number"))) == STOPPED:
103	            continue
104	        if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X"):
105	            out.append(m.get("text", "").strip())
106	    return sorted(set(out))
107	
108	
109	def compare(old, new, vol):
110	    diffs = []
111	    old_err, new_err = errors(old["messages"]), errors(new["messages"])
112	    if old_err != new_err:
113	        diffs.append({"what": "messages", "old": old_err, "new": new_err})
114	    for table in old["tables"]:
115	        a = normalise_rows(old["tables"][table], vol.get(table, set()))
116	        b = normalise_rows(new["tables"].get(table, []), vol.get(table, set()))
117	        if a != b:
118	            only_old = [json.loads(x) for x in a if x not in b]
119	            only_new = [json.loads(x) for x in b if x not in a]
120	            diffs.append({"what": f"rows of {table}", "old_only": only_old, "new_only": only_new})
121	    return diffs
122	
123	
124	def load_driver(tcode):
125	    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "driver.py")
126	    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("driver", path)
127	    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
128	    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
129	    return mod
130	
131	
132	class RecordingClient(odata.Client):
133	    """Keeps every message the service sent during one case."""
134	
135	    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
136	        super().__init__(*a, **kw)
137	        self.seen = []
138	
139	    def call(self, method, path, data=None, headers=None):
140	        r = super().call(method, path, data, headers)
141	        self.seen.extend(r.messages)
142	        return r
143	
144	    def ui(self, type_, text):
145	        r = super().ui(type_, text)
146	        self.seen.append({"type": type_, "text": text, "from": "ui"})
147	        return r
148	
149	
150	def grade(tcode, cases, report_name="ZPP_RESTORE", oracle_report="ZPP_ORACLE_G", s=None, sealed_answers=None):
151	    s = s or sap.Sap()
152	    fields = table_fields(tcode)
153	    vol = volatile_fields(tcode)
154	    os.environ["ORACLE_REPORT"] = oracle_report
155	    t0 = time.time()
156	    old = oracle.replay(tcode, cases, s)
157	    t_old = time.time() - t0
158	    baseline = read_tables(s, fields)
159	    restore = abap.build(report_name, restore_report(baseline, fields))
160	    s.write_program(report_name, restore)
161	    service = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "service.json"))
162	    driver = load_driver(tcode)
163	    results = []
164	    t1 = time.time()
165	    for case in cases:
166	        client = RecordingClient(service["root"], s)
167	        crash = None
168	        try:
169	            driver.run(client, case["steps"])
170	        except Exception as e:  # the driver failing is a result too
171	            crash = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
172	        new = {"messages": client.seen, "tables": read_tables(s, fields)}
173	        s.run_program(report_name)
174	        diffs = compare(old[case["id"]], new, vol)
175	        if crash:
176	            diffs.insert(0, {"what": "driver crashed", "error": crash})
177	        drift = None
178	        if sealed_answers is not None:
179	            sealed_old = sealed_answers.get(case["id"])
180	            if sealed_old is None or compare(sealed_old, old[case["id"]], vol):
181	                drift = "the old transaction answered differently than when the cases were sealed"
182	        results.append({"id": case["id"], "intent": case.get("intent", ""), "pass": not diffs, "diffs": diffs,
183	                        "old_messages": errors(old[case["id"]]["messages"]), "new_messages": client.seen,
184	                        "drift": drift})
185	    t_new = time.time() - t1
186	    after = read_tables(s, fields)
187	    clean = all(normalise_rows(after[t], vol[t]) == normalise_rows(baseline[t], vol[t]) for t in fields)
188	    passed = sum(r["pass"] for r in results)
189	    return {"tcode": tcode, "cases": len(cases), "passed": passed, "failed": len(cases) - passed,
190	            "drift": sum(1 for r in results if r["drift"]), "tables_restored": clean,
191	            "seconds_old": round(t_old, 1), "seconds_new": round(t_new, 1), "results": results}
192	
193	
194	def main(argv):
195	    tcode = argv[0].upper()
196	    out = None
197	    if "--out" in argv:
198	        out = argv[argv.index("--out") + 1]
199	    sealed_answers = None
200	    if "--sealed" in argv:
201	        bundle_path = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "sealed", "bundle.json")
202	        with open(bundle_path, "rb") as f:
203	            raw = f.read()
204	        bundle = json.loads(raw)
205	        cases, sealed_answers = bundle["cases"], bundle["answers"]
206	        print(f"sealed bundle sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}")
207	        report_name, oracle_report = "ZPP_RESTORE", "ZPP_ORACLE_G"
208	    else:
209	        cases = load_json(argv[1])
210	        report_name, oracle_report = "ZPP_RESTORE_P", "ZPP_ORACLE_P"
211	    report = grade(tcode, cases, report_name, oracle_report, sealed_answers=sealed_answers)
212	    text = json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
213	    if out:
214	        with open(out, "w") as f:
215	            f.write(text)
216	    print(f"{report['passed']} of {report['cases']} cases behave the same; tables restored: "
217	          f"{report['tables_restored']}; drift: {report['drift']}")
218	    for r in report["results"]:
219	        if not r["pass"]:
220	            print(f"- {r['id']} {r['intent']}")
221	            for d in r["diffs"]:
222	                print(f"    {json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]}")
223	    return 0 if report["failed"] == 0 else 1
224	
225	
226	if __name__ == "__main__":
227	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
228

1	"""A small OData V4 client for the new service, handed to the port's driver by the grader.
2	
3	The driver never sees credentials: it gets a Client and calls get, post, patch and delete with paths relative to the
4	service root. Every call returns a Response with the status, the JSON body and the messages the service sent (error
5	body and details, and the sap-messages header), each as {"type": "E"|"W"|"S"|"I", "text": ...}.
6	"""
7	import json
8	import os
9	import sys
10	
11	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
12	import sap  # noqa: E402
13	
14	SEVERITY = {1: "S", 2: "I", 3: "W", 4: "E"}
15	
16	
17	class Response:
18	    def __init__(self, status, body, messages):
19	        self.status, self.body, self.messages = status, body, messages
20	
21	    @property
22	    def ok(self):
23	        return 200 <= self.status < 300
24	
25	    def __repr__(self):
26	        return f"Response({self.status}, messages={self.messages})"
27	
28	
29	class Client:
30	    def __init__(self, service_root, s=None):
31	        self.s = s or sap.Sap()
32	        self.root = service_root.rstrip("/") + "/"
33	        self.csrf = None
34	
35	    def _messages(self, headers, body):
36	        out = []
37	        err = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
38	        if err:
39	            details = err.get("details") or []
40	            if not details:
41	                out.append({"type": "E", "text": err.get("message", "")})
42	            for d in details:
43	                out.append({"type": SEVERITY.get(d.get("@Common.numericSeverity"), "E"), "text": d.get("message", "")})
44	            if details and err.get("message") and err["message"] not in [d.get("message") for d in details]:
45	                out.insert(0, {"type": "E", "text": err["message"]})
46	        raw = headers.get("sap-messages") if headers else None
47	        if raw:
48	            try:
49	                for m in json.loads(raw):
50	                    out.append({"type": SEVERITY.get(m.get("numericSeverity"), "I"), "text": m.get("message", "")})
51	            except ValueError:
52	                pass
53	        return out
54	
55	    def call(self, method, path, data=None, headers=None):
56	        if method != "GET" and not self.csrf:
57	            self._fetch_csrf()
58	        url = self.root + path.lstrip("/")
59	        hdrs = {"Accept": "application/json", "Authorization": self.s.auth}
60	        if self.csrf:
61	            hdrs["X-CSRF-Token"] = self.csrf
62	        body = None
63	        if data is not None:
64	            body = json.dumps(data).encode()
65	            hdrs["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
66	        hdrs.update(headers or {})
67	        import urllib.request
68	        import urllib.error
69	        req = urllib.request.Request(url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") + "sap-client=" + self.s.client,
70	                                     data=body, method=method, headers=hdrs)
71	        try:
72	            with self.s.opener.open(req, timeout=120) as resp:
73	                status, h, text = resp.status, resp.headers, resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
74	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
75	            status, h, text = e.code, e.headers, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
76	            if status == 403 and "csrf" in (e.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "") or "").lower():
77	                self.csrf = None
78	                self._fetch_csrf()
79	                return self.call(method, path, data, headers)
80	        try:
81	            parsed = json.loads(text) if text.strip() else {}
82	        except ValueError:
83	            parsed = {"raw": text[:2000]}
84	        return Response(status, parsed, self._messages(h, parsed))
85	
86	    def _fetch_csrf(self):
87	        import urllib.request
88	        req = urllib.request.Request(self.root + "?sap-client=" + self.s.client,
89	                                     headers={"X-CSRF-Token": "Fetch", "Authorization": self.s.auth,
90	                                              "Accept": "application/json"})
91	        with self.s.opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
92	            self.csrf = resp.headers.get("x-csrf-token")
93	
94	    def ui(self, type_, text):
95	        """Record a message the app's UI shows before calling the service (input format only, never a rule)."""
96	        self.ui_messages = getattr(self, "ui_messages", []) + [{"type": type_, "text": text, "from": "ui"}]
97	        return Response(0, {}, [{"type": type_, "text": text}])
98	
99	    def get(self, path, **kw):
100	        return self.call("GET", path, **kw)
101	
102	    def post(self, path, data=None, **kw):
103	        return self.call("POST", path, data if data is not None else {}, **kw)
104	
105	    def patch(self, path, data, **kw):
106	        return self.call("PATCH", path, data, **kw)
107	
108	    def delete(self, path, **kw):
109	        return self.call("DELETE", path, **kw)
110

1	"""Create, change, activate and publish RAP objects through ADT. This is the port agent's tool.
2	
3	    python3 factory/rap.py put KIND NAME FILE [--desc TEXT] [--part implementations]
4	    python3 factory/rap.py activate KIND:NAME [KIND:NAME ...]
5	    python3 factory/rap.py binding NAME SERVICE_DEFINITION [--desc TEXT]
6	    python3 factory/rap.py publish NAME
7	    python3 factory/rap.py get KIND NAME [--part implementations]
8	    python3 factory/rap.py delete KIND NAME
9	    python3 factory/rap.py sql "SELECT ..."
10	
11	KIND is DDLS (CDS view), BDEF (behavior definition), CLAS (class; --part implementations is the local types
12	include of a behavior pool), DDLX (metadata extension), SRVD (service definition) or SRVB (service binding).
13	Objects are local ($TMP). Credentials come from SAP_ENV, the agent's own SAP user.
14	"""
15	import json
16	import os
17	import re
18	import sys
19	import urllib.parse
20	
21	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
22	import sap  # noqa: E402
23	
24	KINDS = {
25	    "DDLS": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddl/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddlSource+xml",
26	             'ddl:ddlSource xmlns:ddl="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlsources"', "DDLS/DF"),
27	    "BDEF": ("/sap/bc/adt/bo/behaviordefinitions", "application/vnd.sap.adt.blues.v1+xml",
28	             'blue:blueSource xmlns:blue="http://www.sap.com/wbobj/blue"', "BDEF/BDO"),
29	    "CLAS": ("/sap/bc/adt/oo/classes", "application/vnd.sap.adt.oo.classes.v4+xml",
30	             'class:abapClass xmlns:class="http://www.sap.com/adt/oo/classes" class:final="true" '
31	             'class:visibility="public"', "CLAS/OC"),
32	    "DDLX": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddlx/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.ddlx.v1+xml",
33	             'ddlx:ddlxSource xmlns:ddlx="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlxsources"', "DDLX/EX"),
34	    "SRVD": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/srvd/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.srvd.v1+xml",
35	             'srvd:srvdSource xmlns:srvd="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/srvdsources" srvd:srvdSourceType="S"',
36	             "SRVD/SRV"),
37	    "SRVB": ("/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/bindings", "application/vnd.sap.adt.businessservices.servicebinding.v2+xml",
38	             None, "SRVB/SVB"),
39	}
40	
41	
42	def q(name):
43	    return urllib.parse.quote(name.lower(), safe="")
44	
45	
46	def uri(kind, name):
47	    return f"{KINDS[kind][0]}/{q(name)}"
48	
49	
50	def source_uri(kind, name, part=None):
51	    if kind == "CLAS" and part:
52	        return f"{uri(kind, name)}/includes/{part}"
53	    return f"{uri(kind, name)}/source/main"
54	
55	
56	def exists(s, kind, name):
57	    try:
58	        s.request("GET", uri(kind, name), accept="*/*")
59	        return True
60	    except sap.SapError as e:
61	        if "HTTP 404" in str(e):
62	            return False
63	        raise
64	
65	
66	def create(s, kind, name, desc):
67	    collection, ctype, root, adt_type = KINDS[kind]
68	    tag = root.split()[0]
69	    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><{root} xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" '
70	            f'adtcore:description="{desc}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="{adt_type}" '
71	            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
72	            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/></{tag}>')
73	    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)
74	
75	
76	def lock(s, object_uri):
77	    _, _, text = s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY", stateful=True,
78	                        accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml;charset=UTF-8;dataname=com.sap.adt.lock.result")
79	    return urllib.parse.quote(re.search(r"<LOCK_HANDLE>(.*?)</LOCK_HANDLE>", text).group(1), safe="")
80	
81	
82	def unlock(s, object_uri, handle):
83	    try:
84	        s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=UNLOCK&lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
85	    except sap.SapError as e:
86	        print(f"warning: unlock failed: {e}")
87	
88	
89	def put(s, kind, name, text, desc=None, part=None):
90	    if not exists(s, kind, name):
91	        create(s, kind, name, desc or name)
92	    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
93	    try:
94	        s.request("PUT", f"{source_uri(kind, name, part)}?lockHandle={handle}", text,
95	                  content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", stateful=True)
96	    finally:
97	        unlock(s, uri(kind, name), handle)
98	
99	
100	def get(s, kind, name, part=None):
101	    return s.source(source_uri(kind, name, part))
102	
103	
104	def activate(s, objects):
105	    refs = "".join(f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:uri="{uri(k, n)}" adtcore:name="{n.upper()}"/>'
106	                   for k, n in objects)
107	    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
108	            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">{refs}</adtcore:objectReferences>')
109	    _, _, text = s.post("/sap/bc/adt/activation?method=activate&preauditRequested=true", body,
110	                        content_type="application/xml")
111	    messages = []
112	    for m in re.finditer(r"<msg\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</msg>", text, re.S):
113	        attrs, inner = m.group(1), m.group(2)
114	        kind = re.search(r'type="(\w)"', attrs)
115	        where = re.search(r'href="([^"]*)"', attrs)
116	        txt = " ".join(re.findall(r"<txt>(.*?)</txt>", inner, re.S))
117	        messages.append(f"{kind.group(1) if kind else '?'} {urllib.parse.unquote(where.group(1)) if where else ''}: "
118	                        f"{txt}")
119	    return messages
120	
121	
122	def binding(s, name, srvd, desc=None):
123	    collection, ctype, _, _ = KINDS["SRVB"]
124	    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><srvb:serviceBinding '
125	            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" xmlns:srvb="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ServiceBindings" '
126	            f'srvb:releaseSupported="false" srvb:published="false" srvb:bindingCreated="true" '
127	            f'adtcore:description="{desc or name}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" '
128	            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
129	            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/>'
130	            f'<srvb:services srvb:name="{name.upper()}"><srvb:content srvb:version="0001">'
131	            f'<srvb:serviceDefinition adtcore:name="{srvd.upper()}"/></srvb:content></srvb:services>'
132	            f'<srvb:binding srvb:type="ODATA" srvb:version="V4" srvb:category="0">'
133	            f'<srvb:implementation adtcore:name=""/></srvb:binding></srvb:serviceBinding>')
134	    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)
135	
136	
137	def publish(s, name):
138	    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
139	            'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">'
140	            f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}"/>'
141	            '</adtcore:objectReferences>')
142	    _, _, text = s.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/odatav4/publishjobs?servicename={name.upper()}"
143	                        "&serviceversion=0001", body, content_type="application/xml", accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml")
144	    return sap.short(text, 600)
145	
146	
147	def delete(s, kind, name):
148	    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
149	    s.request("DELETE", f"{uri(kind, name)}?lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
150	
151	
152	def main(argv):
153	    args, opts = [], {}
154	    it = iter(argv)
155	    for a in it:
156	        if a.startswith("--"):
157	            opts[a[2:]] = next(it)
158	        else:
159	            args.append(a)
160	    s = sap.Sap()
161	    cmd = args[0]
162	    prefix = os.environ.get("RAP_PREFIX", "ZPP_").upper()
163	    names = [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:3]] if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete", "binding") else \
164	        [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:]] if cmd in ("activate", "publish") else []
165	    if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete") and len(args) > 2:
166	        names = [args[2]]
167	    bad = [n for n in names if not n.upper().startswith(prefix)]
168	    if bad:
169	        print(f"refused: names must start with {prefix}: {bad}")
170	        return 2
171	    if cmd == "put":
172	        kind, name, path = args[1].upper(), args[2], args[3]
173	        with open(path) as f:
174	            put(s, kind, name, f.read(), opts.get("desc"), opts.get("part"))
175	        print(f"saved {kind} {name.upper()} (not active yet: run activate)")
176	    elif cmd == "get":
177	        print(get(s, args[1].upper(), args[2], opts.get("part")))
178	    elif cmd == "activate":
179	        objects = [tuple(a.split(":", 1)) for a in args[1:]]
180	        messages = activate(s, [(k.upper(), n) for k, n in objects])
181	        errors = [m for m in messages if m.startswith(("E", "A"))]
182	        print("\n".join(messages) if messages else "activated")
183	        return 1 if errors else 0
184	    elif cmd == "binding":
185	        binding(s, args[1], args[2], opts.get("desc"))
186	        print(f"created service binding {args[1].upper()} for {args[2].upper()}; activate it, then publish")
187	    elif cmd == "publish":
188	        print(publish(s, args[1]))
189	    elif cmd == "delete":
190	        delete(s, args[1].upper(), args[2])
191	        print("deleted")
192	    elif cmd == "sql":
193	        print(json.dumps(s.sql(args[1], rows=int(opts.get("rows", 500))), indent=1))
194	    else:
195	        print(__doc__)
196	        return 2
197	    return 0
198	
199	
200	if __name__ == "__main__":
201	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
202

"""Create, change, activate and publish RAP objects through ADT. This is the port agent's tool.

    python3 factory/rap.py put KIND NAME FILE [--desc TEXT] [--part implementations]
    python3 factory/rap.py activate KIND:NAME [KIND:NAME ...]
    python3 factory/rap.py binding NAME SERVICE_DEFINITION [--desc TEXT]
    python3 factory/rap.py publish NAME
    python3 factory/rap.py get KIND NAME [--part implementations]
    python3 factory/rap.py delete KIND NAME
    python3 factory/rap.py sql "SELECT ..."

KIND is DDLS (CDS view), BDEF (behavior definition), CLAS (class; --part implementations is the local types
include of a behavior pool), DDLX (metadata extension), SRVD (service definition) or SRVB (service binding).
Objects are local ($TMP). Credentials come from SAP_ENV, the agent's own SAP user.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import urllib.parse

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import sap  # noqa: E402

KINDS = {
    "DDLS": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddl/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddlSource+xml",
             'ddl:ddlSource xmlns:ddl="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlsources"', "DDLS/DF"),
    "BDEF": ("/sap/bc/adt/bo/behaviordefinitions", "application/vnd.sap.adt.blues.v1+xml",
             'blue:blueSource xmlns:blue="http://www.sap.com/wbobj/blue"', "BDEF/BDO"),
    "CLAS": ("/sap/bc/adt/oo/classes", "application/vnd.sap.adt.oo.classes.v4+xml",
             'class:abapClass xmlns:class="http://www.sap.com/adt/oo/classes" class:final="true" '
             'class:visibility="public"', "CLAS/OC"),
    "DDLX": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddlx/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.ddlx.v1+xml",
             'ddlx:ddlxSource xmlns:ddlx="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlxsources"', "DDLX/EX"),
    "SRVD": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/srvd/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.srvd.v1+xml",
             'srvd:srvdSource xmlns:srvd="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/srvdsources" srvd:srvdSourceType="S"',
             "SRVD/SRV"),
    "SRVB": ("/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/bindings", "application/vnd.sap.adt.businessservices.servicebinding.v2+xml",
             None, "SRVB/SVB"),
}


def q(name):
    return urllib.parse.quote(name.lower(), safe="")


def uri(kind, name):
    return f"{KINDS[kind][0]}/{q(name)}"


def source_uri(kind, name, part=None):
    if kind == "CLAS" and part:
        return f"{uri(kind, name)}/includes/{part}"
    return f"{uri(kind, name)}/source/main"


def exists(s, kind, name):
    try:
        s.request("GET", uri(kind, name), accept="*/*")
        return True
    except sap.SapError as e:
        if "HTTP 404" in str(e):
            return False
        raise


def create(s, kind, name, desc):
    collection, ctype, root, adt_type = KINDS[kind]
    tag = root.split()[0]
    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><{root} xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" '
            f'adtcore:description="{desc}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="{adt_type}" '
            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/></{tag}>')
    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)


def lock(s, object_uri):
    _, _, text = s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY", stateful=True,
                        accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml;charset=UTF-8;dataname=com.sap.adt.lock.result")
    return urllib.parse.quote(re.search(r"<LOCK_HANDLE>(.*?)</LOCK_HANDLE>", text).group(1), safe="")


def unlock(s, object_uri, handle):
    try:
        s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=UNLOCK&lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
    except sap.SapError as e:
        print(f"warning: unlock failed: {e}")


def put(s, kind, name, text, desc=None, part=None):
    if not exists(s, kind, name):
        create(s, kind, name, desc or name)
    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
    try:
        s.request("PUT", f"{source_uri(kind, name, part)}?lockHandle={handle}", text,
                  content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", stateful=True)
    finally:
        unlock(s, uri(kind, name), handle)


def get(s, kind, name, part=None):
    return s.source(source_uri(kind, name, part))


def activate(s, objects):
    refs = "".join(f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:uri="{uri(k, n)}" adtcore:name="{n.upper()}"/>'
                   for k, n in objects)
    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">{refs}</adtcore:objectReferences>')
    _, _, text = s.post("/sap/bc/adt/activation?method=activate&preauditRequested=true", body,
                        content_type="application/xml")
    messages = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<msg\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</msg>", text, re.S):
        attrs, inner = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        kind = re.search(r'type="(\w)"', attrs)
        where = re.search(r'href="([^"]*)"', attrs)
        txt = " ".join(re.findall(r"<txt>(.*?)</txt>", inner, re.S))
        messages.append(f"{kind.group(1) if kind else '?'} {urllib.parse.unquote(where.group(1)) if where else ''}: "
                        f"{txt}")
    return messages


def binding(s, name, srvd, desc=None):
    collection, ctype, _, _ = KINDS["SRVB"]
    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><srvb:serviceBinding '
            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" xmlns:srvb="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ServiceBindings" '
            f'srvb:releaseSupported="false" srvb:published="false" srvb:bindingCreated="true" '
            f'adtcore:description="{desc or name}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" '
            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/>'
            f'<srvb:services srvb:name="{name.upper()}"><srvb:content srvb:version="0001">'
            f'<srvb:serviceDefinition adtcore:name="{srvd.upper()}"/></srvb:content></srvb:services>'
            f'<srvb:binding srvb:type="ODATA" srvb:version="V4" srvb:category="0">'
            f'<srvb:implementation adtcore:name=""/></srvb:binding></srvb:serviceBinding>')
    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)


def publish(s, name):
    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
            'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">'
            f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}"/>'
            '</adtcore:objectReferences>')
    _, _, text = s.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/odatav4/publishjobs?servicename={name.upper()}"
                        "&serviceversion=0001", body, content_type="application/xml", accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml")
    return sap.short(text, 600)


def delete(s, kind, name):
    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
    s.request("DELETE", f"{uri(kind, name)}?lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)


def main(argv):
    args, opts = [], {}
    it = iter(argv)
    for a in it:
        if a.startswith("--"):
            opts[a[2:]] = next(it)
        else:
            args.append(a)
    s = sap.Sap()
    cmd = args[0]
    prefix = os.environ.get("RAP_PREFIX", "ZPP_").upper()
    names = [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:3]] if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete", "binding") else \
        [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:]] if cmd in ("activate", "publish") else []
    if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete") and len(args) > 2:
        names = [args[2]]
    bad = [n for n in names if not n.upper().startswith(prefix)]
    if bad:
        print(f"refused: names must start with {prefix}: {bad}")
        return 2
    if cmd == "put":
        kind, name, path = args[1].upper(), args[2], args[3]
        with open(path) as f:
            put(s, kind, name, f.read(), opts.get("desc"), opts.get("part"))
        print(f"saved {kind} {name.upper()} (not active yet: run activate)")
    elif cmd == "get":
        print(get(s, args[1].upper(), args[2], opts.get("part")))
    elif cmd == "activate":
        objects = [tuple(a.split(":", 1)) for a in args[1:]]
        messages = activate(s, [(k.upper(), n) for k, n in objects])
        errors = [m for m in messages if m.startswith(("E", "A"))]
        print("\n".join(messages) if messages else "activated")
        return 1 if errors else 0
    elif cmd == "binding":
        binding(s, args[1], args[2], opts.get("desc"))
        print(f"created service binding {args[1].upper()} for {args[2].upper()}; activate it, then publish")
    elif cmd == "publish":
        print(publish(s, args[1]))
    elif cmd == "delete":
        delete(s, args[1].upper(), args[2])
        print("deleted")
    elif cmd == "sql":
        print(json.dumps(s.sql(args[1], rows=int(opts.get("rows", 500))), indent=1))
    else:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1	"""Talk to an SAP system through its ADT REST interface.
2	
3	Credentials come from an env file with A4H_USER, A4H_PASSWORD and A4H_CLIENT (default ~/.config/evolve/a4h.env, or
4	SAP_ENV). The base URL is SAP_URL, by default a local SSH tunnel. One Sap object keeps one set of cookies, so it uses
5	one security session on the server instead of one per request.
6	"""
7	import base64
8	import http.cookiejar
9	import os
10	import re
11	import urllib.error
12	import urllib.parse
13	import urllib.request
14	import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
15	
16	DEFAULT_ENV = "~/.config/evolve/a4h.env"
17	DEFAULT_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:15000"
18	PACKAGE = "$TMP"
19	
20	
21	class SapError(Exception):
22	    pass
23	
24	
25	def load_env(path):
26	    values = {}
27	    with open(os.path.expanduser(path)) as f:
28	        for line in f:
29	            line = line.strip()
30	            if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
31	                key, value = line.split("=", 1)
32	                values[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
33	    return values
34	
35	
36	class Sap:
37	    def __init__(self, env=None, url=None):
38	        values = load_env(env or os.environ.get("SAP_ENV", DEFAULT_ENV))
39	        self.user = values["A4H_USER"]
40	        self.client = values["A4H_CLIENT"]
41	        token = base64.b64encode(f"{self.user}:{values['A4H_PASSWORD']}".encode()).decode()
42	        self.auth = "Basic " + token
43	        self.url = (url or os.environ.get("SAP_URL", DEFAULT_URL)).rstrip("/")
44	        self.jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
45	        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(self.jar))
46	        self.csrf = None
47	
48	    # -- plumbing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
49	
50	    def request(self, method, path, body=None, content_type=None, accept="*/*", stateful=False, retry=True):
51	        url = self.url + path + ("&" if "?" in path else "?") + "sap-client=" + self.client
52	        headers = {"Authorization": self.auth, "Accept": accept, "X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf or "Fetch"}
53	        if content_type:
54	            headers["Content-Type"] = content_type
55	        if stateful:
56	            headers["X-sap-adt-sessiontype"] = "stateful"
57	        data = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body
58	        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers=headers)
59	        try:
60	            with self.opener.open(req, timeout=300) as resp:
61	                self.csrf = resp.headers.get("x-csrf-token", self.csrf)
62	                return resp.status, resp.headers, resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
63	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
64	            text = e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
65	            if e.code == 403 and retry and "csrf" in (e.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "") + text).lower():
66	                self.csrf = None
67	                self.fetch_csrf()
68	                return self.request(method, path, body, content_type, accept, stateful, retry=False)
69	            raise SapError(f"{method} {path}: HTTP {e.code}: {short(text)}") from None
70	
71	    def fetch_csrf(self):
72	        self.request("GET", "/sap/bc/adt/discovery", accept="application/atomsvc+xml")
73	
74	    def post(self, path, body="", **kw):
75	        if not self.csrf:
76	            self.fetch_csrf()
77	        return self.request("POST", path, body, **kw)
78	
79	    # -- reading ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
80	
81	    def sql(self, query, rows=5000):
82	        """Run an Open SQL SELECT through the data preview and return a list of dicts (values as strings)."""
83	        _, _, text = self.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/datapreview/freestyle?rowNumber={rows}", query,
84	                               content_type="text/plain", accept="application/xml, application/vnd.sap.adt.datapreview.table.v1+xml")
85	        root = ET.fromstring(text)
86	        columns = []
87	        for col in root.iter():
88	            if local(col.tag) != "columns":
89	                continue
90	            name, values = None, []
91	            for child in col:
92	                if local(child.tag) == "metadata":
93	                    name = attr(child, "name")
94	                elif local(child.tag) == "dataSet":
95	                    values = [(d.text or "") for d in child]
96	            columns.append((name, values))
97	        count = max((len(v) for _, v in columns), default=0)
98	        return [{name: values[i].rstrip() for name, values in columns} for i in range(count)]
99	
100	    def source(self, uri):
101	        _, _, text = self.request("GET", uri, accept="text/plain")
102	        return text
103	
104	    def program_source(self, name):
105	        return self.source(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/{q(name)}/source/main")
106	
107	    def include_source(self, name):
108	        return self.source(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/includes/{q(name)}/source/main")
109	
110	    # -- writing and running ABAP -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	
112	    def write_program(self, name, source, description="Proof Port helper"):
113	        """Create the report if needed, replace its source and activate it. Local objects only ($TMP)."""
114	        uri = f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/{q(name)}"
115	        if not self.exists(uri):
116	            body = (
117	                '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
118	                '<program:abapProgram xmlns:program="http://www.sap.com/adt/programs/programs" '
119	                'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" '
120	                f'adtcore:description="{description}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="PROG/P" '
121	                f'adtcore:responsible="{self.user}">'
122	                f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{PACKAGE}"/></program:abapProgram>'
123	            )
124	            self.post("/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs", body,
125	                      content_type="application/vnd.sap.adt.programs.programs.v2+xml")
126	        _, _, text = self.post(f"{uri}?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY", stateful=True,
127	                               accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml;charset=UTF-8;dataname=com.sap.adt.lock.result")
128	        handle = urllib.parse.quote(re.search(r"<LOCK_HANDLE>(.*?)</LOCK_HANDLE>", text).group(1), safe="")
129	        try:
130	            self.request("PUT", f"{uri}/source/main?lockHandle={handle}", source,
131	                         content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", stateful=True)
132	        finally:
133	            try:
134	                self.post(f"{uri}?_action=UNLOCK&lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
135	            except SapError as e:
136	                print(f"warning: unlock of {name} failed: {e}")
137	        self.activate(uri, name)
138	
139	    def activate(self, uri, name):
140	        body = (
141	            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
142	            '<adtcore:objectReferences xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">'
143	            f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:uri="{uri}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}"/>'
144	            '</adtcore:objectReferences>'
145	        )
146	        _, _, text = self.post("/sap/bc/adt/activation?method=activate&preauditRequested=true", body,
147	                               content_type="application/xml")
148	        errors = re.findall(r'<msg[^>]*type="E"[^>]*>.*?<txt>(.*?)</txt>', text, re.S)
149	        if errors:
150	            raise SapError(f"activating {name}: " + " | ".join(errors))
151	
152	    def exists(self, uri):
153	        try:
154	            self.request("GET", uri, accept="application/vnd.sap.adt.programs.programs.v2+xml, application/xml")
155	            return True
156	        except SapError as e:
157	            if "HTTP 404" in str(e):
158	                return False
159	            raise
160	
161	    def run_program(self, name):
162	        """Run a report without a selection screen and return its list output as text."""
163	        _, _, text = self.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programrun/{q(name)}", accept="text/plain")
164	        return text
165	
166	    def run_abap(self, source, name="ZPP_RUN"):
167	        self.write_program(name, source)
168	        return self.run_program(name)
169	
170	
171	def local(tag):
172	    return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
173	
174	
175	def attr(el, name):
176	    for key, value in el.attrib.items():
177	        if local(key) == name:
178	            return value
179	    return None
180	
181	
182	def q(name):
183	    return urllib.parse.quote(name.lower(), safe="")
184	
185	
186	def short(text, n=400):
187	    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
188	    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()[:n]
189

1	# Brief: port {TCODE} to RAP
2	
3	The custom SAP transaction {TCODE} (program {PROG}) is being rewritten as a RAP business object with an OData V4
4	service and a Fiori Elements app, on the same database tables. Afterwards a grader runs cases you have not seen
5	through the old screen and through your service, each from the same data, and compares the error messages and every
6	table row. Your job is to make the new one behave the same, and to say honestly where it doesn't.
7	
8	## What you have
9	
10	- `runs/{TCODE}/extract/`: everything the factory read. `summary.json` first, then `source/`, `screens.json` (fields
11	  and flow logic per screen), `status.json` (function codes), `dictionary.json` (tables, fields, domains).
12	- `python3 factory/rap.py ...`: create, activate and publish RAP objects (run it without arguments for usage). Every
13	  name must start with `{PREFIX}`. Activation errors come back with the line.
14	- `python3 factory/oracle.py {TCODE} CASES.json OUT.json`: ask the old transaction what it does for cases you write.
15	  The case format is at the top of `factory/oracle.py`.
16	- `python3 factory/grade.py {TCODE} CASES.json`: runs your own cases through the old screen and through your driver
17	  and new service, and prints every difference. This is the same grader that will judge you.
18	- `factory/odata.py`: the client your driver gets.
19	
20	Keep your own cases in `runs/{TCODE}/port/my_cases.json`. Write as many as you need.
21	
22	## What to deliver, in runs/{TCODE}/port/
23	
24	1. **RAP objects on SAP**, all named `{PREFIX}...`: CDS view entities over the same tables, a behavior definition, a
25	   behavior pool with the validations, determinations and actions that reproduce the old checks, with message texts
26	   identical to the old ones, writes to the same tables the old program writes (including any log), a service
27	   definition, and an OData V4 UI service binding, activated and published. A metadata extension with UI annotations
28	   so that a Fiori Elements list report and object page work for a person.
29	2. **`src/`**: the source of every object you made, one file each (`NAME.ddls`, `.bdef`, `.clas.abap`,
30	   `.clas.locals_imp.abap`, `.ddlx`, `.srvd`), identical to what is active.
31	3. **`service.json`**: `{"root": "/sap/opu/odata4/sap/<binding>/srvd/sap/<service definition>/0001/",
32	   "objects": [["DDLS", "NAME"], ...]}`, every object you made, lowercase names in the root.

# Brief: port {TCODE} to RAP

The custom SAP transaction {TCODE} (program {PROG}) is being rewritten as a RAP business object with an OData V4
service and a Fiori Elements app, on the same database tables. Afterwards a grader runs cases you have not seen
through the old screen and through your service, each from the same data, and compares the error messages and every
table row. Your job is to make the new one behave the same, and to say honestly where it doesn't.

## What you have

- `runs/{TCODE}/extract/`: everything the factory read. `summary.json` first, then `source/`, `screens.json` (fields
  and flow logic per screen), `status.json` (function codes), `dictionary.json` (tables, fields, domains).
- `python3 factory/rap.py ...`: create, activate and publish RAP objects (run it without arguments for usage). Every
  name must start with `{PREFIX}`. Activation errors come back with the line.
- `python3 factory/oracle.py {TCODE} CASES.json OUT.json`: ask the old transaction what it does for cases you write.
  The case format is at the top of `factory/oracle.py`.
- `python3 factory/grade.py {TCODE} CASES.json`: runs your own cases through the old screen and through your driver
  and new service, and prints every difference. This is the same grader that will judge you.
- `factory/odata.py`: the client your driver gets.

Keep your own cases in `runs/{TCODE}/port/my_cases.json`. Write as many as you need.

## What to deliver, in runs/{TCODE}/port/

1. **RAP objects on SAP**, all named `{PREFIX}...`: CDS view entities over the same tables, a behavior definition, a
   behavior pool with the validations, determinations and actions that reproduce the old checks, with message texts
   identical to the old ones, writes to the same tables the old program writes (including any log), a service
   definition, and an OData V4 UI service binding, activated and published. A metadata extension with UI annotations
   so that a Fiori Elements list report and object page work for a person.
2. **`src/`**: the source of every object you made, one file each (`NAME.ddls`, `.bdef`, `.clas.abap`,
   `.clas.locals_imp.abap`, `.ddlx`, `.srvd`), identical to what is active.
3. **`service.json`**: `{"root": "/sap/opu/odata4/sap/<binding>/srvd/sap/<service definition>/0001/",
   "objects": [["DDLS", "NAME"], ...]}`, every object you made, lowercase names in the root.
4. **`driver.py`** with `def run(client, steps)`. It does with the new service what the case's screen steps do on the
   old screen, the way a person using the new app would. `client` is an `odata.Client`: `get`, `post`, `patch`,
   `delete` with paths relative to the service root; the messages the service sends are collected for you. The
   driver translates screens to calls: which field is which property, which function code means save, back or
   cancel, what typed text means. It holds no business rule: every check lives in the RAP object. The one exception
   is what a UI checks before it calls anything (typed text that is not a number, for example): record that with
   `client.ui("E", text)`. The driver must not read or write tables, run reports or call the old transaction.
5. **`REPORT.md`**: what you built; each old rule and where it lives now; what you could not reproduce; what you
   assumed about screen sequences; and what you noticed that comparing messages and rows cannot show.

## Rules

- Don't read `runs/*/sealed/` or `runs/*/work/`. The permissions block it; don't look for other ways.
- Don't change the old program, the tables' definitions, or any object that doesn't start with `{PREFIX}`. Change
  data only through your service, the oracle or the grader.
- The new service must not call the old transaction or its code: no CALL TRANSACTION, SUBMIT, batch input or
  PERFORM IN PROGRAM.
- The old screen remembers between presses: a field keeps its value after an error, a later screen shows what an
  earlier one loaded, pressing Enter on a screen that saves on a function code does nothing. Decide what a step
  sequence means for the new app, and write it down in REPORT.md.
- Old screens take what fingers type: `!` clears a field, `10.` is not ten, `5-` is minus five in SAP, and this SAP
  user writes numbers as 1.234,56 and dates as DD.MM.YYYY. Ask the oracle how the old screen takes each, and match it.
- If something you started keeps running, stop only that; never `pkill -f`.
- You are done when the grader shows no differences on your own cases (or you can explain each one in REPORT.md),
  and everything is active and published. End with a short summary.

"""Run a generated ABAP report and read back what it writes.

The report writes records as JSON. A list line is limited in width, so each record goes out in chunks of 200
characters, every chunk between '>' and '|' so that trailing spaces survive, and '<<END>>' closes the record.
"""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import sap  # noqa: E402

OUT_FORM = r"""
FORM out USING iv_kind TYPE csequence iv_json TYPE string.
  DATA lv_all TYPE string.
  DATA lv_line TYPE string.
  DATA lv_off TYPE i.
  DATA lv_len TYPE i.
  DATA lv_n TYPE i.
  lv_all = iv_kind && ` ` && iv_json.
  lv_len = strlen( lv_all ).
  WHILE lv_off < lv_len.
    lv_n = nmin( val1 = 200 val2 = lv_len - lv_off ).
    lv_line = '>' && substring( val = lv_all off = lv_off len = lv_n ) && '|'.
    WRITE / lv_line.
    lv_off = lv_off + lv_n.
  ENDWHILE.
  WRITE / '<<END>>'.
ENDFORM.
"""


def build(name, body, types=""):
    return f"REPORT {name.lower()} LINE-SIZE 255 NO STANDARD PAGE HEADING.\n{types}\nSTART-OF-SELECTION.\n{body}\n{OUT_FORM}"


def parse(text):
    records, buf = [], []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.rstrip()
        if line.startswith(">") and line.endswith("|"):
            buf.append(line[1:-1])
        elif line.strip() == "<<END>>":
            record = "".join(buf)
            kind, _, payload = record.partition(" ")
            records.append((kind, payload))
            buf = []
    return records


def run(s, name, body, types=""):
    return parse(s.run_abap(build(name, body, types), name=name))
"""Stage 4: have a second agent port the transaction, walled off from the sealed cases.

Before it starts, the sealed cases and the test author's transcript are moved out of the project into a vault
folder, and the agent's permissions deny reading them anyway. The agent signs in to SAP as its own user (SAP_ENV),
may only create objects named RAP_PREFIX..., and may write only inside runs/<TCODE>/port/. Its transcript goes to
runs/<TCODE>/logs/port_transcript.jsonl. Afterwards check.py searches that transcript and the port for every case.

    python3 factory/port.py ZCRED ZPP_CR_ [model]
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import vault  # noqa: E402


def main(tcode, prefix, model="opus"):
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "extract", "summary.json")) as f:
        summary = json.load(f)
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "factory", "briefs", "port.md")) as f:
        brief = (f.read().replace("{TCODE}", tcode).replace("{PROG}", summary["program"])
                 .replace("{PREFIX}", prefix))
    brief += "\nName your own cases p001, p002, ... so they are easy to tell apart from anyone else's.\n"
    vault.lock(tcode)
    port = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port")
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(port, "src"), exist_ok=True)
    logs = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "logs")
    os.makedirs(logs, exist_ok=True)
    allowed = ",".join([
        "Read", "Glob", "Grep",
        f"Write(runs/{tcode}/port/**)", f"Edit(runs/{tcode}/port/**)",
        "Bash(python3 factory/rap.py *)",
        f"Bash(python3 factory/oracle.py {tcode} *)",
        f"Bash(python3 factory/grade.py {tcode} *)",
        "Bash(ls *)", "Bash(wc *)", "Bash(mkdir -p runs/*)",
    ])
    denied = ",".join(["Read(runs/*/sealed/**)", "Read(runs/*/work/**)", "Read(runs/*/logs/**)",
                       "Read(~/.config/**)", "Bash(pkill *)"])
    cmd = ["claude", "-p", brief, "--model", model, "--allowedTools", allowed, "--disallowedTools", denied,
           "--output-format", "stream-json", "--verbose", "--max-turns", "500"]
    env = dict(os.environ, SAP_ENV=os.path.expanduser("~/.config/evolve/a4h_agent.env"), RAP_PREFIX=prefix,
               ORACLE_REPORT="ZPP_ORACLE_P")
    log = os.path.join(logs, "port_transcript.jsonl")
    with open(log, "w") as out:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)
    with open(log) as f:
        for line in f:
            try:
                event = json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if event.get("type") == "result":
                print(f"cost {event.get('total_cost_usd')} USD, {event.get('num_turns')} turns, "
                      f"{round(event.get('duration_ms', 0) / 60000, 1)} min")
                print(event.get("result", ""))
    return proc.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1].upper(), sys.argv[2].upper(), *sys.argv[3:]))

CLASS lhc_customer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    CONSTANTS:
      c_blocked  TYPE zcr_customer-blocked  VALUE 'X',
      c_priority TYPE zcr_customer-priority VALUE 'V'.

    " screen 0200 PBO, MODULE lock_priority: the new limit is display only for a priority customer
    METHODS get_instance_features FOR INSTANCE FEATURES
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_features FOR Customer RESULT result.

    " screen 0100 PAI, MODULE check_customer
    METHODS choosecustomer FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION Customer~ChooseCustomer.

    " screen 0200 PAI with function code SAVE
    METHODS changecreditlimit FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION Customer~ChangeCreditLimit.

    " FORM save_change: IF gv_new_limit = 0. gs_cust-blocked = 'X'. ENDIF.
    METHODS blockwhenzero FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR Customer~blockWhenZero.

    " MODULE check_change, in the old order
    METHODS checkchange FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR Customer~checkChange.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_customer IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_instance_features.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( Priority )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    result = VALUE #( FOR ls_customer IN lt_customer
                      ( Customer           = ls_customer-Customer
                        %field-CreditLimit = COND #( WHEN ls_customer-Priority = c_priority
                                                     THEN if_abap_behv=>fc-f-read_only
                                                     ELSE if_abap_behv=>fc-f-unrestricted ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD choosecustomer.

    DATA ls_customer TYPE zcr_customer.

    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).

      CLEAR ls_customer.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_key-%param-Customer
        INTO @ls_customer.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer not found' ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_customer-blocked = c_blocked.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer is blocked' ) ) TO reported-customer.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD changecreditlimit.

    DATA ls_customer TYPE zcr_customer.
    DATA lv_new      TYPE zcr_customer-credit_limit.

    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).

      CLEAR ls_customer.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_key-Customer
        INTO @ls_customer.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_key-Customer ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_key-Customer
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer not found' ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      lv_new = ls_key-%param-NewLimit.
      IF ls_customer-priority = c_priority.
        " the field is display only, so it still holds the limit the customer was loaded with
        lv_new = ls_customer-credit_limit.
      ENDIF.

      DELETE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WHERE kunnr = ls_key-Customer.
      INSERT VALUE #( kunnr     = ls_key-Customer
                      waers     = ls_customer-waers
                      old_limit = ls_customer-credit_limit
                      new_limit = lv_new
                      reason    = ls_key-%param-Reason
                      checked   = abap_false ) INTO TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY Customer
          UPDATE FIELDS ( CreditLimit )
          WITH VALUE #( ( Customer    = ls_key-Customer
                          CreditLimit = lv_new ) )
        FAILED   DATA(ls_failed)
        REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).

      APPEND LINES OF ls_failed-customer   TO failed-customer.
      APPEND LINES OF ls_reported-customer TO reported-customer.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD blockwhenzero.

    DATA lt_update TYPE TABLE FOR UPDATE zpp_cr_c_customer.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( CreditLimit Blocked )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    LOOP AT lt_customer INTO DATA(ls_customer).
      IF ls_customer-CreditLimit = 0 AND ls_customer-Blocked <> c_blocked.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer
                        Blocked  = c_blocked ) TO lt_update.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY Customer
          UPDATE FIELDS ( Blocked )
          WITH lt_update
        REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).
      APPEND LINES OF ls_reported-customer TO reported-customer.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD checkchange.

    DATA ls_db        TYPE zcr_customer.
    DATA lv_threshold TYPE zcr_limit_rule-threshold.
    DATA lv_reason    TYPE zcr_changelog-reason.
    DATA lv_text      TYPE string.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( CreditLimit )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    LOOP AT lt_customer INTO DATA(ls_customer).

      CLEAR: ls_db, lv_threshold, lv_reason, lv_text.

      READ TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WITH KEY kunnr = ls_customer-Customer
        INTO DATA(ls_pending).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_reason = ls_pending-reason.
      ENDIF.

      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_customer-Customer
        INTO @ls_db.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_text = 'Customer not found'.
      ELSEIF ls_db-blocked = c_blocked.
        lv_text = 'Customer is blocked'.
      ELSEIF ls_customer-CreditLimit < 0.
        lv_text = 'Credit limit cannot be negative'.
      ELSEIF ls_customer-CreditLimit = ls_db-credit_limit.
        lv_text = 'Credit limit is unchanged'.
      ELSE.
        SELECT SINGLE threshold FROM zcr_limit_rule
          WHERE waers = @ls_db-waers
          INTO @lv_threshold.
        IF ls_customer-CreditLimit > lv_threshold AND lv_reason IS INITIAL.
          lv_text = 'A reason is required for this limit'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = lv_text ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      " the change passed every check: hand the log row's values to the additional save
      READ TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WITH KEY kunnr = ls_customer-Customer
        ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_pending>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <ls_pending>-waers     = ls_db-waers.
        <ls_pending>-old_limit = ls_db-credit_limit.
        <ls_pending>-new_limit = ls_customer-CreditLimit.
        <ls_pending>-checked   = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        INSERT VALUE #( kunnr     = ls_customer-Customer
                        waers     = ls_db-waers
                        old_limit = ls_db-credit_limit
                        new_limit = ls_customer-CreditLimit
                        reason    = lv_reason
                        checked   = abap_true ) INTO TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS lsc_zpp_cr_c_customer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_saver.

  PROTECTED SECTION.

    " FORM save_change: INSERT zcr_changelog FROM ls_log
    METHODS save_modified REDEFINITION.
    METHODS cleanup_finalize REDEFINITION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lsc_zpp_cr_c_customer IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD save_modified.

    DATA ls_log TYPE zcr_changelog.

    LOOP AT update-customer INTO DATA(ls_update).

      READ TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WITH KEY kunnr = ls_update-Customer
        INTO DATA(ls_pending).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_pending-checked = abap_false.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR ls_log.
      GET TIME STAMP FIELD ls_log-changed_at.
      ls_log-kunnr     = ls_pending-kunnr.
      ls_log-waers     = ls_pending-waers.
      ls_log-old_limit = ls_pending-old_limit.
      ls_log-new_limit = ls_pending-new_limit.
      ls_log-uname     = sy-uname.
      ls_log-reason    = ls_pending-reason.

      INSERT zcr_changelog FROM @ls_log.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_finalize.

    CLEAR zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
