input.content:
"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

_namespace = None


def namespace(client):
    """The action namespace of the published service, read once from the service metadata."""
    global _namespace
    if _namespace is None:
        _namespace = SERVICE_NAMESPACE
        try:
            raw = client.get("$metadata").body.get("raw", "")
            found = re.search(r'Namespace="(com\.sap\.gateway\.srvd[^"]*)"', raw)
            if found:
                _namespace = found.group(1)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return _namespace


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN if body.strip("+") == "" else ERR_NUMERIC
    if " " in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    if any(c not in "0123456789.," for c in body):
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    whole, _, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if "." in fraction or "," in fraction:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

_namespace = None


def namespace(client):
    """The action namespace of the published service, read once from the service metadata."""
    global _namespace
    if _namespace is None:
        _namespace = SERVICE_NAMESPACE
        try:
            raw = client.get("$metadata").body.get("raw", "")
            found = re.search(r'Namespace="(com\.sap\.gateway\.srvd[^"]*)"', raw)
            if found:
                _namespace = found.group(1)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return _namespace


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN if body.strip("+") == "" else ERR_NUMERIC
    if " " in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    if any(c not in "0123456789.," for c in body):
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    whole, _, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if "." in fraction or "," in fraction:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                          namespace(self.client)),
                         {"NewLimit": str(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN if body.strip("+") == "" else ERR_NUMERIC
    if " " in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    if any(c not in "0123456789.," for c in body):
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    whole, _, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if "." in fraction or "," in fraction:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                          namespace(self.client)),
                         {"NewLimit": str(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN if body.strip("+") == "" else ERR_NUMERIC
    if " " in body:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    if any(c not in "0123456789.," for c in body):
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    whole, _, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if "." in fraction or "," in fraction:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        saved = self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                                  namespace(self.client)),
                                 {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        print("DEBUG save status=%r body=%r" % (saved.status, str(saved.body)[:1500]))
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

tool_use_result.originalFile:
"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;

shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"

SCREEN_FIELDS = {

    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):                # nothing to read as a number
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    whole, separator, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if separator and fraction and not fraction.isdigit():  # junk behind the decimal separator
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    elif groups[0] and not groups[0].isdigit():
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show

def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text

        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                          namespace(self.client)),
                         {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                          namespace(self.client)),
                         {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):                # nothing to read as a number
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    whole, separator, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if separator and fraction and not fraction.isdigit():  # junk behind the decimal separator
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    elif groups[0] and not groups[0].isdigit():
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):                # nothing to read as a number
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    whole, separator, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if separator and fraction and not fraction.isdigit():  # junk behind the decimal separator
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    elif groups[0] and not groups[0].isdigit():
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:

            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:

            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):

        if self.screen == "0100":

    def open_customer(self):

                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        print("DEBUG get %r" % (shown.body,))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        saved = self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                                  namespace(self.client)),
                                 {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        print("DEBUG save %r %r %r" % (float(self.limit), saved.status, str(saved.body)[:120]))
        print("DEBUG log %r" % (str(self.client.get("ChangeLog").body)[:600],))
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        saved = self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                                  namespace(self.client)),
                                 {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        print("DEBUG save %r %r %r" % (float(self.limit), saved.status, str(saved.body)[:120]))
        print("DEBUG log %r" % (str(self.client.get("ChangeLog").body)[:600],))
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return

CLASS lhc_customer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    CONSTANTS:
      c_blocked  TYPE zcr_customer-blocked  VALUE 'X',
      c_priority TYPE zcr_customer-priority VALUE 'V'.

    " screen 0200 PBO, MODULE lock_priority: the new limit is display only for a priority customer
    METHODS get_instance_features FOR INSTANCE FEATURES
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_features FOR Customer RESULT result.

    " screen 0100 PAI, MODULE check_customer
    METHODS choosecustomer FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION Customer~ChooseCustomer.

    " screen 0200 PAI with function code SAVE
    METHODS changecreditlimit FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION Customer~ChangeCreditLimit.

    " FORM save_change: IF gv_new_limit = 0. gs_cust-blocked = 'X'. ENDIF.
    METHODS blockwhenzero FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR Customer~blockWhenZero.

    " MODULE check_change, in the old order
    METHODS checkchange FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR Customer~checkChange.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_customer IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_instance_features.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( Priority )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    result = VALUE #( FOR ls_customer IN lt_customer
                      ( Customer           = ls_customer-Customer
                        %field-CreditLimit = COND #( WHEN ls_customer-Priority = c_priority
                                                     THEN if_abap_behv=>fc-f-read_only
                                                     ELSE if_abap_behv=>fc-f-unrestricted ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD choosecustomer.

    DATA ls_customer TYPE zcr_customer.

    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).

      CLEAR ls_customer.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_key-%param-Customer
        INTO @ls_customer.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer not found' ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_customer-blocked = c_blocked.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( %cid = ls_key-%cid
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer is blocked' ) ) TO reported-customer.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD changecreditlimit.

    DATA ls_customer TYPE zcr_customer.
    DATA lv_new      TYPE zcr_customer-credit_limit.

    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).

      CLEAR ls_customer.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_key-Customer
        INTO @ls_customer.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_key-Customer ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_key-Customer
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = 'Customer not found' ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      lv_new = ls_key-%param-NewLimit.
      IF ls_customer-priority = c_priority.
        " the field is display only, so it still holds the limit the customer was loaded with
        lv_new = ls_customer-credit_limit.
      ENDIF.

      DELETE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WHERE kunnr = ls_key-Customer.
      INSERT VALUE #( kunnr     = ls_key-Customer
                      waers     = ls_customer-waers
                      old_limit = ls_customer-credit_limit
                      new_limit = lv_new
                      reason    = ls_key-%param-Reason
                      checked   = abap_false ) INTO TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY Customer
          UPDATE FIELDS ( CreditLimit )
          WITH VALUE #( ( Customer    = ls_key-Customer
                          CreditLimit = lv_new ) )
        FAILED   DATA(ls_failed)
        REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).

      APPEND LINES OF ls_failed-customer   TO failed-customer.
      APPEND LINES OF ls_reported-customer TO reported-customer.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD blockwhenzero.

    DATA lt_update TYPE TABLE FOR UPDATE zpp_cr_c_customer.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( CreditLimit Blocked )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    LOOP AT lt_customer INTO DATA(ls_customer).
      IF ls_customer-CreditLimit = 0 AND ls_customer-Blocked <> c_blocked.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer
                        Blocked  = c_blocked ) TO lt_update.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY Customer
          UPDATE FIELDS ( Blocked )
          WITH lt_update
        REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD checkchange.

    DATA ls_db        TYPE zcr_customer.
    DATA lv_threshold TYPE zcr_limit_rule-threshold.
    DATA lv_reason    TYPE zcr_changelog-reason.
    DATA lv_text      TYPE string.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_cr_c_customer IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY Customer
        FIELDS ( CreditLimit )
        WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_customer).

    LOOP AT lt_customer INTO DATA(ls_customer).

      CLEAR: ls_db, lv_threshold, lv_reason, lv_text.

      READ TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WITH KEY kunnr = ls_customer-Customer
        INTO DATA(ls_pending).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_reason = ls_pending-reason.
      ENDIF.

      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zcr_customer
        WHERE kunnr = @ls_customer-Customer
        INTO @ls_db.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_text = 'Customer not found'.
      ELSEIF ls_db-blocked = c_blocked.
        lv_text = 'Customer is blocked'.
      ELSEIF ls_customer-CreditLimit < 0.
        lv_text = 'Credit limit cannot be negative'.
      ELSEIF ls_customer-CreditLimit = ls_db-credit_limit.
        lv_text = 'Credit limit is unchanged'.
      ELSE.
        SELECT SINGLE threshold FROM zcr_limit_rule
          WHERE waers = @ls_db-waers
          INTO @lv_threshold.
        IF ls_customer-CreditLimit > lv_threshold AND lv_reason IS INITIAL.
          lv_text = 'A reason is required for this limit'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer ) TO failed-customer.
        APPEND VALUE #( Customer = ls_customer-Customer
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = lv_text ) ) TO reported-customer.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      " the change passed every check: hand the log row's values to the additional save
      READ TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending WITH KEY kunnr = ls_customer-Customer
        ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_pending>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <ls_pending>-waers     = ls_db-waers.
        <ls_pending>-old_limit = ls_db-credit_limit.
        <ls_pending>-new_limit = ls_customer-CreditLimit.
        <ls_pending>-checked   = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        INSERT VALUE #( kunnr     = ls_customer-Customer
                        waers     = ls_db-waers
                        old_limit = ls_db-credit_limit
                        new_limit = ls_customer-CreditLimit
                        reason    = lv_reason
                        checked   = abap_true ) INTO TABLE zpp_cr_bp_customer=>pending.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS lsc_zpp_cr_c_customer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_saver.

  PROTECTED SECTION.

    " FORM save_change: INSERT zcr_changelog FROM ls_log
    METHODS save_modified REDEFINITION.
    METHODS cleanup_finalize REDEFINITION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lsc_zpp_cr_c_customer IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD save_modified.

    DATA ls_log TYPE zcr_changelog.

    LOOP AT update-customer INTO DATA(ls_update).

"""Do with the new service what the old ZCRED screens did with the typed steps.

The old transaction is two screens. Screen 0100 takes a customer number and any key looks it up; screen 0200
shows what was loaded, takes a new credit limit and a reason, and saves on the function code SAVE. The new app is
a Fiori Elements list report over the same customers with two actions: ChooseCustomer (the number typed on screen
0100) and ChangeCreditLimit (the new limit and the reason, pressed with SAVE on screen 0200).

This module only translates: which field is which property, what a function code means, and what the typed text is
worth. Every check is in the RAP behavior pool. The one thing decided here is what the app's own input fields do
before anything is called:

  * a field holds at most as many characters as the old screen's field did; more and the step cannot be typed;
  * the new limit is a number field in the SAP user's notation (1.234,56) and the app refuses what is not one,
    with the same two messages the old screen showed (recorded with client.ui, never a rule);
  * '!' in the first position clears a field, as it does on any SAP screen;
  * the new limit is read-only when the service says so (CreditLimitFc = 1, which the service derives from the
    customer's priority), so the app offers no field to type in.

A step sequence stops being processed when the old screen would have stopped: an error message (batch input gives
up), a saved change (the old transaction ends), a system command that leaves the transaction, or a step naming a
screen that is not the one in front of the user.
"""

import re
import urllib.parse
from decimal import Decimal

SERVICE_NAMESPACE = "com.sap.gateway.srvd.zpp_cr_ui_credit.v0001"
ENTITY_SET = "Customer"

# the input fields of the old screens and how many characters each one holds
SCREEN_FIELDS = {
    "0100": {"GV_KUNNR": 10},
    "0200": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": 17, "GV_REASON": 60},
}

# what the dynpro says about text it cannot read as a number
MSG_FORMAT = "Formatting error in the field GV_NEW_LIMIT; see next message"
ERR_SIGN = "Specify positive values only"
ERR_NUMERIC = "Enter a numeric value"
ERR_PATTERN = "Input must be in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__"
ERR_TOO_LONG = "Entry too long (enter in the format _.___.___.___.__~,__)"

# a system command typed into the command field leaves the transaction
MSG_TERMINATED = "The transaction was terminated by the user"
LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE = ("/N", "/I")

def absolute(client):
    """service.json names the service by its path; point the client at it on its own system."""
    if "://" not in client.root:
        client.root = client.s.url.rstrip("/") + "/" + client.root.lstrip("/")


def namespace(client):
    """The namespace the bound actions live in; the service metadata of the binding names it."""
    return SERVICE_NAMESPACE


def parse_amount(text):
    """What the old screen's DEC field makes of typed text, in this user's notation (1.234,56).

    Returns (value, None) or (None, message).
    """
    if text[:1] == "!":                                   # '!' clears the field
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if body == "":
        return Decimal("0.00"), None
    if "-" in body:                                       # the field has no sign
        return None, ERR_SIGN
    if not any(c.isdigit() for c in body):                # nothing to read as a number
        return (Decimal("0.00"), None) if body == "," else (None, ERR_PATTERN)
    if "+" in body:
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    whole, separator, fraction = body.partition(",")
    if separator and fraction and not fraction.isdigit():  # junk behind the decimal separator
        return None, ERR_NUMERIC
    if len(fraction) > 2:
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    groups = whole.split(".")
    if len(groups) > 1:
        if any(len(g) != 3 or not g.isdigit() for g in groups[1:]):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
        if groups[0] and (len(groups[0]) > 3 or not groups[0].isdigit()):
            return None, ERR_PATTERN
    elif groups[0] and not groups[0].isdigit():
        return None, ERR_PATTERN
    digits = "".join(groups)
    if len(digits.lstrip("0")) > 13:                      # more than the field can show
        return None, ERR_TOO_LONG
    return Decimal((digits or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]), None


def function_code(step):
    """The function code of a step, as the screen would see it."""
    code = str(step.get("ok", "/00")).strip().upper()
    if code.startswith("="):
        code = code[1:].strip()
    return code or "/00"


def errors(response):
    return [m for m in response.messages if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X")]


class Session:
    """One run of the transaction: which screen the user is on and what the fields hold."""

    def __init__(self, client):
        absolute(client)
        self.client = client
        self.screen = "0100"
        self.over = False
        self.customer = None
        self.limit = Decimal("0.00")
        self.reason = ""
        self.locked = False
        self.typed = {}

    # -- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def step(self, step):
        if self.over or step.get("screen") != self.screen:
            return False
        fields = SCREEN_FIELDS[self.screen]
        for name, text in (step.get("fields") or {}).items():
            text = "" if text is None else str(text)
            if name not in fields or len(text) > fields[name]:
                return False                               # the app has no such field, or it is too short
            if self.screen == "0200" and name == "GV_NEW_LIMIT" and self.locked:
                return False                               # the service says the limit cannot be typed
            self.typed[name] = text
        code = function_code(step)
        if code.startswith("/") and code != "/00":
            if code.startswith(LEAVE_WITH_MESSAGE):
                self.client.ui("A", MSG_TERMINATED)
            return False                                   # a system command leaves the transaction
        if self.screen == "0100":
            return self.open_customer()
        return self.screen_0200(code)

    # -- screen 0100 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def open_customer(self):
        number = self.typed.get("GV_KUNNR", "").upper().rstrip(" ")
        chosen = self.client.post("%s/%s.ChooseCustomer" % (ENTITY_SET, namespace(self.client)),
                                  {"Customer": number})
        if errors(chosen):
            self.over = True
            return False
        shown = self.client.get("%s(%s)?$select=CreditLimit,CreditLimitFc"
                                % (ENTITY_SET, key(number)))
        if errors(shown):
            self.over = True
            return False
        self.customer = number
        self.limit = Decimal(str(shown.body.get("CreditLimit", "0")))
        self.locked = str(shown.body.get("CreditLimitFc", "7")) == "1"
        self.reason = ""                                   # MODULE user_command_0100 clears the reason
        self.typed = {}
        self.screen = "0200"
        return True

    # -- screen 0200 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def screen_0200(self, code):
        if "GV_NEW_LIMIT" in self.typed:
            value, message = parse_amount(self.typed.pop("GV_NEW_LIMIT"))
            if message:
                self.client.ui("E", MSG_FORMAT)
                self.client.ui("E", message)
                self.over = True
                return False
            self.limit = value
        if "GV_REASON" in self.typed:
            text = self.typed.pop("GV_REASON")
            self.reason = "" if text[:1] == "!" else text
        if code != "SAVE":
            return True                                    # nothing happens; the fields keep what they hold
        self.client.post("%s(%s)/%s.ChangeCreditLimit" % (ENTITY_SET, key(self.customer),
                                                          namespace(self.client)),
                         {"NewLimit": float(self.limit), "Reason": self.reason})
        self.over = True                                   # saved: the old transaction ends here
        return False


def key(customer):
    return "'" + urllib.parse.quote(customer.replace("'", "''"), safe="") + "'"


def run(client, steps):
    session = Session(client)
    for step in steps:
        if not session.step(step):
            return
